items.difficulty_reason: 11 行、模幂零理想完美 ⇒ 完美：按 perfect 定义选 K⊗R/I 的有限有限投射代表；lift-complex-projectives 引理给代表 K 的投射 R-模复形 P 且 P/IP 即所选复形；每个 P^n 是投射 R-模、其模 I 约化在 R/I 上有限投射，由 Nakayama（代数章 NAK 引理）得 P^n 有限生成投射，故 P 是有限有限投射复形、K 完美。承重全在 span 内；3 处引用（2 同章、1 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-perfect-modulo-nilpotent-ideal (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 20508-20517

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the choice of a finite complex of finite projective R/I-modules representing the derived quotient, the lifting to a complex of projective R-modules representing K whose reduction is the chosen complex, and the application of Nakayama's lemma to conclude the lifting is termwise finite projective (source lines 20519-20529)
